[페르소나 - 요한나] [지속] [해제 불가] : 
기능 : 페르소나를 통해 자신을 강화합니다.
효과 1 : [핵열 부스터 : 우월 코드 공격 대미지 {1}% ▲] [지속] [해제 불가]
효과 2 : [방어의 마음가짐 : 방어력 {2}% ▲] [지속] [해제 불가]

[공격력 {5}% ▲] [{6}초 유지]

[최종 공격력 {3}% 분배 대미지]

text.en:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
Persona - Johanna: This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Function: Queen (Makoto) strengthens herself using her Persona.
Effect 1: Nuke Boost: Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲ {1}% continuously. This effect cannot be removed.
Effect 2: Defense Master: DEF ▲ {2}% continuously. This effect cannot be removed.
■ Activates at the start of battle and when Full Burst ends. Affects self.
ATK ▲ {5}% for {6} sec.
■ Activates when 1 More takes effect. Affects all enemies.
Deals {3}% of final ATK as distributed damage.
■ Activates when Follow Up takes effect. Affects all enemies.
Deals {4}% of final ATK as distributed damage.
text.ja:

「ペルソナ - ヨハンナ」「持続」「解除不可」：

効果1：「核熱ブースタ：有利コードの攻撃ダメージ{1}％▲」「持続」「解除不可」

■追撃が適用された時、敵全体に

text.en:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
Attack Damage ▲ {9}% continuously.
■ Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects self.
Fist of Justice!: This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Function: Queen (Makoto) strengthens herself.
Effect 1: Nuke Amp: Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲ {1}% continuously. This effect cannot be removed.
Effect 2: Rakukaja: DEF ▲ {2}% continuously. This effect cannot be removed.

■ Activates when entering Burst Stage 3. Affects self.
Distributed Damage ▲ {3}% for {4} sec.
■ Activates when 1 More takes effect. Affects all standard Burst {5} allies (except the skill user) in the Persona state.
Baton Pass: ATK ▲ {6}% of the skill user's ATK continuously. Stacks up to {7} times.
